purpose: City-specific official registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry review.
assessment: Official documents establish an open public parcel search/map service and Mersin-local cadastre office. The exact WUP coordinate request reached the API but was stopped by its daily query limit; no feature or absence is inferred.
registryAssessment: The official TKGM Parsel Sorgu service is documented as a free public parcel-map/query service with coordinate, address and administrative search and parcel area, sheet, type, coordinates and KML/PDF outputs; the official Mersin Cadastre Directorate is the local office. Anonymous point API request was rate-limited before returning a feature, so no polygon was verified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official TKGM page describes the public/free Parsel Sorgu search and map, supported coordinate/address/admin inputs, parcel area, sheet, type, coordinates and KML/PDF output; owner name and Turkish identity-number lookup are not offered.
Official local Mersin Cadastre Directorate contact page.
Official portal entry for the parcel-query app; portal also presents authenticated access options.

searchQueries.query: Mersin Turkey official cadastral parcels public map land registry GIS TKGM
searchQueries.result: TKGM documents a free public parcel search/map with coordinates, parcel area, sheet/type and KML/PDF outputs; exact anonymous coordinate request hit the service daily limit.

searchQueries.query: Mersin parsel sorgu kadastro müdürlüğü resmi parsel haritası koordinat sorgulama
searchQueries.result: Resmî TKGM Parsel Sorgu ücretsiz parsel haritası ve koordinat/adres/idarî arama, alan, pafta, nitelik, koordinat ve KML/PDF çıktılarını belgeliyor; Mersin Kadastro Müdürlüğü yerel birimdir. Anonim koordinat isteği günlük sorgu sınırına takıldı.

serviceChecks.observation: Exact ranked-point anonymous coordinate request with official portal Referer/Origin returned 'Günlük sorgu limitini aştınız.' (daily query limit exceeded). This is rate limiting, not a zero-feature response; no geometry was returned and the endpoint was not retried.

privacy: Only safe source-native parcel identifiers and geometry are retained where returned. No owner, address, title, account or tax data were requested.

geometryAttempt.status: HTTP 403 daily query limit exceeded before feature response

remainingUncertainty: Whether this exact point resolves to a polygon and what safe polygon schema/coverage the API returns after the daily limit resets.
